utc_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with exactly millisecond precision, e.g. 2026-10-10T10:07:55.000Z (xtime.Format). format alone would also accept offsets.

decimal_string.description: Money or quantity as a plain-notation decimal string: no exponent, no leading zeros, no plus sign.

sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 lower-case hex characters.

uuid.description: UUID in canonical lower-case form (google/uuid String()).
